verdict.rationale: Muse links personal data sources (email, calendar, health, finances) and can build dashboards/trackers to surface patterns (e.g., sleep patterns, spending trackers) and proactively monitors and follows up on goals, which constitutes data-driven insight generation. However, evidence is mostly first-party marketing language without concrete examples of insight quality or independent verification of the analytical depth of suggestions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of actual insight accuracy/usefulness, more detail on the range of insight types beyond a few examples, and confirmation these are 'AI-generated insights' distinct from simple task automation.
